# Written by `make plans`: each statement `go test ./...` runs outside test
# files, its callers, and its plan on an empty database at the latest schema.

## api.(*Server).handleChatDelete
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE cwd = ? AND session_id != ?
    SCAN sessions

## chatimport.Save.func1
INSERT INTO sessions(session_id, cwd, project, model, started_at, last_event_at, worked_at, status, agent, title, prompt, native_id, chat) VALUES(?, '', '', ?, ?, ?, ?, 'ended', ?, ?, ?, ?, 1) ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET model = COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.model, ''), sessions.model), title = COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.title, ''), sessions.title), prompt = COALESCE(NULLIF(sessions.prompt, ''), excluded.prompt), started_at = MIN(sessions.started_at, excluded.started_at), last_event_at = MAX(sessions.last_event_at, excluded.last_event_at), worked_at = MAX(sessions.worked_at, excluded.worked_at)

    SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## codex.(*Ingester).codexRows
SELECT id, ts, COALESCE(key,''), kind, COALESCE(model,''), internal, CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN COALESCE(json_extract(payload,'$.cwd'),'') ELSE '' END, COALESCE(tokens_in,0), COALESCE(tokens_out,0), COALESCE(cache_read,0), COALESCE(cache_write,0), COALESCE(cost_usd,0) FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND source = ?
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## deepseek.(*Ingester).dropKeys.func1

## deepseek.repairTimes
UPDATE sessions SET last_event_at = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM events WHERE sid = sessions.sid) WHERE session_id = ?1 AND last_event_at = ?2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE sid = sessions.sid)
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)

## deepseek.repairTimes
UPDATE sessions SET started_at = (SELECT MIN(ts) FROM events WHERE sid = sessions.sid) WHERE session_id = ?1 AND started_at = ?2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE sid = sessions.sid)
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)

## deepseek.repairTimes
UPDATE sessions SET worked_at = COALESCE((SELECT MAX(ts) FROM events WHERE sid = sessions.sid AND kind IN ('turn.user','turn.assistant','tool.pre','tool.post')), 0) WHERE session_id = ?1 AND worked_at = ?2
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=?)

## hermes.(*Ingester).pending

    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## ingest.BackfillCompactions

## ingest.BackfillTitles

## ingest.BackfillToolMessageIDs
SELECT e.id, COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload,'$.tool_use_id'),''), COALESCE(se.transcript_path,'') FROM events e JOIN sessions se ON se.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'tool.pre' AND e.msg_id IS NULL AND e.source IN ('hook', 'transcript') AND e.id > ? AND COALESCE(se.transcript_path,'') != '' ORDER BY e.id LIMIT ?
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=? AND id>?)
    SEARCH se USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## ingest.BackfillToolMessageIDs
UPDATE events SET msg_id = ? WHERE id = ? AND msg_id IS NULL
    SEARCH events USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## ingest.RepairAssistantText
SELECT e.id, se.session_id, COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload,'$.message_id'),''), COALESCE(se.transcript_path,'') FROM events e JOIN sessions se ON se.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND COALESCE(se.transcript_path,'') != '' AND (json_extract(e.payload,'$.text') LIKE '%…' OR json_extract(e.payload,'$.text') LIKE '%'||char(65533)||'%')
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
    SEARCH se USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## ingest.RepairEmptyAssistantText
SELECT e.id, se.session_id, json_extract(e.payload,'$.message_id'), se.transcript_path FROM events e JOIN sessions se ON se.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.source = 'transcript' AND COALESCE(se.transcript_path,'') != '' AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload,'$.text'),'') = '' AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload,'$.message_id'),'') != ''
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
    SEARCH se USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## opencode.(*Ingester).refreshInputs
SELECT key FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND key >= 'oc-tool:' AND key < 'oc-tool;' AND source = ? AND kind = 'tool.pre' AND json_valid(payload) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload, '$.tool_input') WHERE json_each.key != 'file_path')
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_sid_key (sid=? AND key>? AND key<?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 3:

## opencode.(*Ingester).refreshInputs.func1
UPDATE events SET payload = json_set(payload, '$.tool_input', json(?), '$.cwd', ?) WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND key = ? AND json_valid(payload)
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_sid_key (sid=? AND key=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## opencode.(*Ingester).refreshText

AND source = ? AND kind = 'turn.assistant' AND msg_id IS NOT NULL AND json_valid(payload)
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## relay.PullRequests
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.tool_response.gitOperation.pr.number'), 0) AS INTEGER), COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.tool_response.gitOperation.pr.url'), '') FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND kind = 'tool.post' AND json_extract(payload, '$.tool_response.gitOperation.pr.action') = 'created' ORDER BY ts
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## rollup.(*Recorder).PriceUnpriced
SELECT e.id, e.ts, s.session_id, e.model, COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0), COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0), COALESCE(e.cache_read,0), COALESCE(e.cache_write,0), COALESCE(e.cache_write_1h,0), COALESCE(s.project,'') FROM events e LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = ? AND e.cost_usd IS NULL AND COALESCE(e.model,'') != '' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0) > 0
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## rollup.(*Recorder).PriceUnpriced.func1

    SEARCH events USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## rollup.(*Recorder).RebuildCodexDaily

    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## rollup.(*Recorder).RebuildCodexDaily.func1, rollup.(*Recorder).RepairForkedTurns.func1, rollup.(*Recorder).RepairSessionModels.func1

## rollup.(*Recorder).RebuildCodexDaily.func1
UPDATE daily_stats SET tokens_total = ?, cost_usd = ? WHERE day = ? AND project = ? AND model = ? AND (tokens_total != ? OR abs(cost_usd - ?) > 1e-9)
    SEARCH daily_stats USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_daily_stats_1 (day=? AND project=? AND model=?)

## rollup.(*Recorder).RepairForkedTurns.func1
UPDATE events SET tokens_in = 0, tokens_out = 0, cache_read = 0, cache_write = 0, cache_write_1h = NULL, cost_usd = 0 WHERE id = ?
    SEARCH events USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## rollup.(*Recorder).RepairForkedTurns.func1
WITH shared AS ( SELECT msg_id FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_turn_msg WHERE kind = 'turn.assistant' AND msg_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY msg_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sid) > 1 ) SELECT e.id, e.ts, e.msg_id, s.session_id, COALESCE(e.model,''), e.internal, COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0), COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0), COALESCE(e.cache_read,0), COALESCE(e.cache_write,0), COALESCE(e.cache_write_1h,0), COALESCE(e.cost_usd,0), COALESCE(s.project,''), COALESCE(s.cwd,'') FROM events e JOIN shared USING (msg_id) LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' ORDER BY e.msg_id, e.id
    CO-ROUTINE shared
        SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_msg (msg_id>?)
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
    BLOOM FILTER ON shared (msg_id=?)
    SEARCH shared USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (msg_id=?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## rollup.(*Recorder).RepairSessionModels.func1
WITH ranked AS ( SELECT e.sid, e.model, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.sid ORDER BY e.ts DESC, e.id DESC) AS rn FROM events e WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.model, '') != '' AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ) UPDATE sessions SET model = ranked.model FROM ranked WHERE ranked.sid = sessions.sid AND ranked.rn = 1 AND COALESCE(sessions.model, '') != ranked.model
    MATERIALIZE ranked
        CO-ROUTINE (subquery-3)
            SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
        SCAN (subquery-3)
    SCAN ranked
    SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## rollup.(*Recorder).correct
SELECT e.id, e.ts, s.session_id, e.model, e.cost_usd, COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0), COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0), COALESCE(e.cache_read,0), COALESCE(e.cache_write,0), COALESCE(e.cache_write_1h,0), COALESCE(s.project,'') FROM events e LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = ? AND e.cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND e.model LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## rollup.(*Recorder).correct.func1

    SEARCH events USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.(*Store).CompactPayloadsStep.func1

    SEARCH events USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.(*Store).MoveEventsStep.func1
INSERT INTO events(id, ts, sid, source, kind, tool, payload, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd, key, model, cache_write_1h, agent_id, msg_id, touch_dir, tool_bytes, internal, inner_tool) SELECT m.id, m.ts, s.sid, m.source, m.kind, m.tool, m.payload, m.tokens_in, m.tokens_out, m.cache_read, m.cache_write, m.cost_usd, m.key, m.model, m.cache_write_1h, m.agent_id, m.msg_id, m.touch_dir, m.tool_bytes, m.internal, m.inner_tool FROM temp.events_moving m JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = m.session_id WHERE true ORDER BY m.id ON CONFLICT(sid, key) WHERE key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
    SCAN m
    SEARCH s USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.(*Store).MoveEventsStep.func1
INSERT INTO session_gen(session_id, gen) SELECT DISTINCT session_id, 1 FROM temp.events_moving WHERE true ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = gen + 1
    SCAN temp.events_moving
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR DISTINCT

## store.(*Store).MoveEventsStep.func1

    SEARCH events_legacy USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid>?)

    CO-ROUTINE (subquery-1)
        SCAN events_legacy
    SEARCH (subquery-1)

## store.(*Store).MoveEventsStep.func1

    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN events_moving

    SEARCH events

## store.(*Store).markToolFieldsPending.func1
INSERT INTO meta(k, v) SELECT ?, COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM events WHERE true ON CONFLICT(k) DO UPDATE SET v = excluded.v
    SEARCH events

## store.(*Store).markToolFieldsPending.func1, store.describeSubagents
SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(v AS INTEGER)), 0) FROM meta WHERE k = 'tool_fields_pending')
    SCAN CONSTANT ROW
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH meta USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_meta_1 (k=?)

## store.ActivityBuckets
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = events.sid), (ts - ?) / ?, COUNT(*) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_ts WHERE ts >= ? AND ts < ? AND kind IN ('turn.assistant', 'tool.pre') AND internal = 0 GROUP BY sid, 2
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_ts (ts>? AND ts<?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.AddDaily
INSERT INTO daily_stats(day, project, model, tokens_total, cost_usd, sessions) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(day, project, model) DO UPDATE SET tokens_total = daily_stats.tokens_total + excluded.tokens_total, cost_usd = daily_stats.cost_usd + excluded.cost_usd, sessions = daily_stats.sessions + excluded.sessions

## store.AddQueuedVia
INSERT INTO queued_messages (session_id, text, created_at, updated_at, via) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

## store.AddStats
INSERT INTO session_stats(session_id, turns, tool_calls, files_touched, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET turns = session_stats.turns + excluded.turns, tool_calls = session_stats.tool_calls + excluded.tool_calls, files_touched = session_stats.files_touched + excluded.files_touched, tokens_in = session_stats.tokens_in + excluded.tokens_in, tokens_out = session_stats.tokens_out + excluded.tokens_out, cache_read = session_stats.cache_read + excluded.cache_read, cache_write = session_stats.cache_write + excluded.cache_write, cost_usd = session_stats.cost_usd + excluded.cost_usd

## store.AdvanceBrainGap
UPDATE brain_gaps SET cursor = ?, reads_done = reads_done + 1, attempts = 0, error = '', status = CASE WHEN ? >= to_event_id THEN 'done' ELSE status END, reads_total = CASE WHEN ? >= to_event_id THEN reads_done + 1 ELSE reads_total END, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
    SEARCH brain_gaps USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.ArchiveProject
UPDATE projects SET archived_at = ? WHERE id = ?
    SEARCH projects USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.AttemptGroup
SELECT session_id, group_id, n, total, base, base_commit, created_at FROM attempts WHERE group_id = ? ORDER BY n
    SEARCH attempts USING INDEX idx_attempts_group (group_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.AttributeTaskCost
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd), 0) FROM task_assignments a JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = a.session_id JOIN events e ON e.sid = s.sid AND e.ts >= a.from_ts AND (a.to_ts IS NULL OR e.ts <= a.to_ts) WHERE a.task_id = ?
    SEARCH a USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_assignments_1 (task_id=?)
    SEARCH s USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts>?)

## store.AttributeTaskCost
UPDATE tasks SET cost_usd = ? WHERE id = ?
    SEARCH tasks USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_tasks_1 (id=?)

## store.BrainAgentNodes
SELECT n.id FROM brain_nodes n WHERE n.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id = n.id AND v.agents = 0) AND NOT (n.vault_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vaults v WHERE v.id = n.vault_id AND v.agents = 0)))
    SEARCH n USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.BrainAgentsSince
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent, ''), 'claude') AS a, COUNT(DISTINCT r.session_id), MAX(r.finished_at) FROM brain_runs r LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.status = 'ok' AND r.finished_at >= ? AND r.session_id != 'caprock:retag' GROUP BY a ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC, a
    SEARCH r USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_finished (finished_at>?)
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR count(DISTINCT)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainAutomation
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM brain_runs a WHERE a.session_id = ? AND a.status = 'skipped' AND a.error = 'automation')
    SEARCH a USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=?)

## store.BrainAutomationSince
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM brain_runs WHERE status = 'skipped' AND error = ? AND finished_at >= ?
    SCAN brain_runs USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session

## store.BrainCandidates
SELECT session_id, project, cwd, repo_root, last_event_at, cursor, max_id, ended FROM ( SELECT s.session_id, COALESCE(s.project, '') AS project, COALESCE(s.cwd, '') AS cwd, COALESCE(s.repo_root, '') AS repo_root, COALESCE(s.last_event_at, 0) AS last_event_at, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(r.through_event_id) FROM brain_runs r WHERE r.session_id = s.session_id AND r.status != 'failed' AND r.gap_id IS NULL AND r.held = 0), 0) AS cursor, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.id) FROM events e WHERE e.sid = s.sid), 0) AS max_id, s.status = 'ended' AS ended, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(r.through_event_id) FROM brain_runs r WHERE r.session_id = s.session_id AND r.held = 1), 0) AS held FROM sessions s WHERE COALESCE(s.last_event_at, 0) >= ? AND (s.status = 'ended' OR COALESCE(s.last_event_at, 0) < ?) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_runs a WHERE a.session_id = s.session_id AND a.status = 'skipped' AND (a.error = 'automation' OR a.error LIKE 'root or home:%')) ) WHERE max_id > cursor AND (ended OR max_id > held) ORDER BY last_event_at DESC LIMIT ?
    SCAN s
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 4
        SEARCH a USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH r USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH r USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH r USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainCatchUp
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reads_done), 0), COALESCE(SUM(MAX(reads_total, reads_done)), 0), COALESCE(SUM(status = 'pending'), 0) FROM brain_gaps WHERE to_event_id IS NOT NULL
    SCAN brain_gaps

## store.BrainCurrentDecisions
SELECT n.id, n.kind, n.title, n.summary, n.session_id, COALESCE(n.event_id, 0), n.source_ts, n.project, n.manual, n.pinned, COALESCE(n.run_id, 0), n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.keywords FROM brain_nodes n WHERE n.project = ? AND n.kind = 'decision' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_edges s WHERE s.dst = n.id AND s.kind = 'supersedes') AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id = n.id AND v.agents = 0) AND NOT (n.vault_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vaults v WHERE v.id = n.vault_id AND v.agents = 0))) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_project (project=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH s USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_supersedes (dst=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.BrainCurrentDecisions
SELECT n.id, n.kind, n.title, n.summary, n.session_id, COALESCE(n.event_id, 0), n.source_ts, n.project, n.manual, n.pinned, COALESCE(n.run_id, 0), n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.keywords FROM brain_nodes n WHERE n.project = ? AND n.kind = 'decision' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_edges s WHERE s.dst = n.id AND s.kind = 'supersedes') ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_project (project=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH s USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_supersedes (dst=?)

    SCAN brain_nodes

## store.BrainEntityTitles

    SCAN n
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainFailures
SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(MAX(finished_at), 0) FROM brain_runs WHERE session_id = ? AND status = 'failed' AND gap_id IS NULL AND id > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM brain_runs WHERE session_id = ? AND status != 'failed' AND gap_id IS NULL), 0)
    SEARCH brain_runs USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=? AND id>?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH brain_runs USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=?)

## store.BrainGapTokensPerRead
SELECT AVG(tokens_in + tokens_out) FROM brain_runs WHERE gap_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'ok'
    SCAN brain_runs

## store.BrainGraphCounts
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brain_nodes WHERE kind = 'topic'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brain_edges e JOIN brain_nodes a ON a.id = e.src JOIN brain_nodes b ON b.id = e.dst WHERE a.kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project') AND b.kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project'))
    SCAN CONSTANT ROW
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN brain_nodes
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN e USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst
        SEARCH a USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
        SEARCH b USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.BrainHandedSince
SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(handoff_brain), 0) FROM sessions WHERE handoff_brain > 0 AND started_at >= ?
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX idx_sessions_handoff_brain (started_at>?)

## store.BrainLastRead
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(finished_at), 0) FROM brain_runs r WHERE r.status = 'ok' AND r.session_id != 'caprock:retag'
    SEARCH r USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_finished

## store.BrainNeighbours
SELECT n.id, n.kind, n.title, n.summary, n.session_id, COALESCE(n.event_id, 0), n.source_ts, n.project, n.manual, n.pinned, COALESCE(n.run_id, 0), n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.keywords, l.kind, l.out, l.weight FROM ( SELECT dst AS other, kind, 1 AS out, weight FROM brain_edges WHERE src = ? UNION ALL SELECT src AS other, kind, 0 AS out, weight FROM brain_edges WHERE dst = ? ) l JOIN brain_nodes n ON n.id = l.other ORDER BY l.weight DESC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT ?
    MERGE (UNION ALL)
        LEFT
            SEARCH brain_edges USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
            SEARCH n USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
        RIGHT
            SEARCH brain_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
            SEARCH n USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainNodeByEvent
SELECT n.id, n.kind, n.title, n.summary, n.session_id, COALESCE(n.event_id, 0), n.source_ts, n.project, n.manual, n.pinned, COALESCE(n.run_id, 0), n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.keywords FROM brain_nodes n WHERE n.event_id = ? AND n.manual = 1 AND n.kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project') ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1
    SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_event (event_id=?)

## store.BrainNodeSources
SELECT s.vault_id, v.name, s.path, s.title, s.aliases, s.excerpt, s.mtime FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id = ? ORDER BY s.id
    SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
    SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.BrainNodeVaults
SELECT s.node_id, v.name FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY s.id DESC
    SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
    SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainNoteSource
SELECT se.session_id, e.ts, COALESCE(se.project, ''), COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') FROM events e LEFT JOIN sessions se ON se.sid = e.sid WHERE e.id = ? AND e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') != ''
    SEARCH e USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    SEARCH se USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.BrainOldWindow
SELECT id, ts, user, text FROM ( SELECT e.id, e.ts, e.kind = 'turn.user' AS user, CASE WHEN e.kind = 'turn.user' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.prompt'), json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') END AS text FROM events e WHERE e.sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND e.id > ? AND e.id <= ? AND +e.kind IN ('turn.user', 'turn.assistant') AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT ? ) WHERE text != '' ORDER BY ts, id
    CO-ROUTINE (subquery-2)
        SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=? AND id>? AND id<?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCAN (subquery-2)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainPassagesBetween
SELECT id, ts, user, text FROM ( SELECT e.id, e.ts, e.kind = 'turn.user' AS user, CASE WHEN e.kind = 'turn.user' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.prompt'), json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') END AS text FROM events e WHERE e.sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND e.id > ? AND e.id <= ? AND +e.kind IN ('turn.user', 'turn.assistant') AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ) WHERE text != '' ORDER BY id LIMIT ?
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=? AND id>? AND id<?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.BrainProjectMemories
SELECT n.id, n.kind, n.title, n.summary, n.session_id, COALESCE(n.event_id, 0), n.source_ts, n.project, n.manual, n.pinned, COALESCE(n.run_id, 0), n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.keywords FROM brain_nodes n WHERE n.project = ? AND n.kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project') AND (n.kind != 'note' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id = n.id AND v.agents = 0)) ORDER BY n.pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_project (project=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainProjectNames
SELECT name FROM projects WHERE archived_at IS NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT project FROM sessions WHERE project IS NOT NULL AND project != ''
    MERGE (UNION)
        LEFT
            SCAN projects
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
        RIGHT
            SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_repo
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR DISTINCT
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainProjects
SELECT project, COUNT(*) FROM brain_nodes n WHERE project != '' AND kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project') AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id = n.id AND v.agents = 0) AND NOT (n.vault_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vaults v WHERE v.id = n.vault_id AND v.agents = 0))) GROUP BY project ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, project LIMIT 200
    SCAN n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_project
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainProjects
SELECT project, COUNT(*) FROM brain_nodes n WHERE project != '' AND kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project') GROUP BY project ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, project LIMIT 200
    SCAN n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_project
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainReadSessions
SELECT s.session_id, COALESCE(s.project, ''), COALESCE(SUM(r.nodes), 0), COALESCE(s.last_event_at, 0) FROM sessions s JOIN brain_runs r ON r.session_id = s.session_id AND r.status != 'failed' AND r.error != 'automation' WHERE COALESCE(s.last_event_at, 0) >= ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_runs a WHERE a.session_id = s.session_id AND a.status = 'skipped' AND a.error LIKE 'root or home:%') GROUP BY s.session_id
    SCAN r
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH a USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

AND n.kind IN ('idea','decision','finding','question') ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT ?

## store.BrainSessionInfo

    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.BrainSpendByProject
SELECT COALESCE(s.project, '') AS p, r.session_id = ? AS rt, SUM(r.status != 'skipped'), SUM(r.tokens_in + r.tokens_out), SUM(r.cost_usd), SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'ok' THEN r.nodes ELSE 0 END) FROM brain_runs r LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.finished_at >= ? GROUP BY p, rt HAVING SUM(r.status != 'skipped') > 0 ORDER BY 4 DESC, 3 DESC, p
    SEARCH r USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_finished (finished_at>?)
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.BrainSpendRows
SELECT r.finished_at, r.tokens_in + r.tokens_out, r.cost_usd, r.status != 'skipped', COALESCE(s.project, ''), r.session_id = ? FROM brain_runs r LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.finished_at >= ? ORDER BY r.finished_at
    SEARCH r USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_finished (finished_at>?)
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.BrainTokensPerRead

    SEARCH brain_runs USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_finished (finished_at>?)

## store.BrainTokensSince
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tokens_in + tokens_out), 0) FROM brain_runs WHERE finished_at >= ?
    SEARCH brain_runs USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_finished (finished_at>?)

## store.BrainUntagged

AND n.kind IN ('idea','decision','finding','question') AND keywords = '' ORDER BY n.id LIMIT ?
    SEARCH n USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid>?)

## store.BrainVaultNotes
SELECT id, vault_id, path, node_id, title, aliases, keys, links, tags, project, excerpt, mtime, size FROM brain_vault_notes WHERE vault_id = ? ORDER BY id
    SEARCH brain_vault_notes USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_brain_vault_notes_1 (vault_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ClaudeTokensSince
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(cache_read,0)+COALESCE(cache_write,0)), 0) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_turn_agent WHERE kind = 'turn.assistant' AND ts >= ? AND internal = 0 AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = 'claude')
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER

## store.CleanBrainVaultEntities
DELETE FROM brain_nodes WHERE vault_id = ? AND kind IN ('topic','person','project') AND pinned = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.src = brain_nodes.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.dst = brain_nodes.id)
    SEARCH brain_nodes USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_vault (vault_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH e USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
    SEARCH brain_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
    SEARCH brain_edges USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_dst (dst=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_edge (src=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_notes USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)

## store.ClearAncestors
SELECT c.parent_session, COALESCE(c.pid, 0), COALESCE(p.pid, 0) FROM sessions c JOIN sessions p ON p.session_id = c.parent_session WHERE c.session_id = ?
    SEARCH c USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.ClearPendingPermission, store.RemoveSession
DELETE FROM pending_permissions WHERE session_id = ?
    SEARCH pending_permissions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_pending_permissions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.ClearQueued
DELETE FROM queued_messages WHERE session_id = ?
    SEARCH queued_messages USING INDEX idx_queued_messages_session (session_id=?)

## store.ClearSuccessor
SELECT c.session_id FROM sessions c JOIN sessions p ON p.session_id = c.parent_session WHERE c.parent_session = ? AND c.pid > 0 AND c.pid = p.pid ORDER BY c.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
    SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCAN c
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.CloseTaskAssignments
UPDATE task_assignments SET to_ts = ? WHERE task_id = ? AND to_ts IS NULL
    SEARCH task_assignments USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_assignments_1 (task_id=?)

## store.CountSessionsQuery
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE ((COALESCE(project,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(cwd,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(git_branch,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR prompt LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR session_id LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR sid IN (SELECT sid FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.user' AND payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')) OR (COALESCE(project,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(cwd,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(git_branch,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR prompt LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR session_id LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR sid IN (SELECT sid FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.user' AND payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')))
    SCAN sessions
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER

ESCAPE '\' OR sid IN (SELECT sid FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.user' AND payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')))

    SEARCH brain_nodes USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.DeleteBrainNode
DELETE FROM brain_nodes WHERE id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND kind IN ('topic','person') AND manual = 0 AND pinned = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.src = brain_nodes.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.dst = brain_nodes.id)
    SEARCH brain_nodes USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH e USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
    SEARCH brain_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
    SEARCH brain_edges USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_dst (dst=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_edge (src=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_notes USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)

## store.DeleteBrainNode
SELECT dst FROM brain_edges WHERE src = ? UNION SELECT src FROM brain_edges WHERE dst = ?
    MERGE (UNION)
        LEFT
            SEARCH brain_edges USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
        RIGHT
            SEARCH brain_edges USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)

## store.EventByKey
SELECT id, ts, (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), source, kind, COALESCE(tool,''), payload, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd, COALESCE(key,''), COALESCE(model,''), cache_write_1h, COALESCE(agent_id,'') FROM events e WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND key = ? AND kind = ?
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_sid_key (sid=? AND key=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.EventsAfter
SELECT id, ts, (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), source, kind, COALESCE(tool,''), payload, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd, COALESCE(key,''), COALESCE(model,''), cache_write_1h, COALESCE(agent_id,'') FROM events e WHERE id > ? ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH e USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid>?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.EventsVersion
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT CAST(v AS INTEGER) FROM meta WHERE k = 'events_moved'), 0) FROM events
    SEARCH events
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH meta USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_meta_1 (k=?)

## store.FindRemovalCandidates
SELECT s.session_id, COALESCE(s.cwd,''), COALESCE(s.project,''), COALESCE(s.agent,''), s.status, COALESCE(s.owned,0), COALESCE(s.last_event_at,0), COALESCE(st.turns,0), COALESCE(st.cost_usd,0) FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_stats st ON st.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.cwd = ? OR substr(s.cwd, 1, ?) = ? OR substr(s.cwd, 1, ?) = ? ORDER BY s.last_event_at
    SCAN s
    SEARCH st USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_stats_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.FindRemovalCandidates

ORDER BY s.last_event_at
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SEARCH st USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_stats_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_user_turn (sid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

    SCAN sessions
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.GetSession
SELECT session_id, COALESCE(cwd,''), COALESCE(project,''), COALESCE(model,''), COALESCE(started_at,0), COALESCE(last_event_at,0), status, COALESCE(transcript_path,''), has_hooks, has_transcript, COALESCE(git_branch,''), COALESCE(version,''), COALESCE(repo_root,''), COALESCE(repo_path,''), COALESCE(owned,0), COALESCE(worktree,''), COALESCE(spawn_command,''), COALESCE(pid,0), exit_code, COALESCE(agent,'claude'), COALESCE(title,''), COALESCE(prompt,''), COALESCE(worked_at,0), COALESCE(parent_session,''), COALESCE(native_id,''), COALESCE(relay_from,''), COALESCE(subscription,''), COALESCE(sessions.name,''), COALESCE(sessions.chat,0), COALESCE(sessions.archived_at,0), COALESCE(sessions.subagent_model,''), COALESCE(sessions.idle_ended_at,0), COALESCE(sessions.idle_ended_after,0), COALESCE((SELECT a.group_id || ' ' || a.n || ' ' || a.total FROM attempts a WHERE a.session_id = sessions.session_id), '') FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH a USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_attempts_1 (session_id=?)

## store.HandoffCoverage
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT project FROM sessions WHERE project != '') p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sessions se CROSS JOIN events e INDEXED BY idx_events_attr_work ON e.sid = se.sid WHERE se.project = p.project AND e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') != '' AND e.ts >= ?1 AND LENGTH(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text')) >= ?2)), COALESCE(( SELECT e.ts FROM events e JOIN sessions se ON se.sid = e.sid WHERE se.project != '' AND e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') != '' AND e.ts >= ?1 AND LENGTH(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text')) >= ?2 ORDER BY e.ts LIMIT 1), 0)
    SCAN CONSTANT ROW
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
        CO-ROUTINE p
            SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_repo
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR DISTINCT
        SCAN p
        CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
            SCAN se USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_repo
            SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts>?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 4
        SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_ts (kind=? AND ts>?)
        SEARCH se USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.HandoffEffect
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND kind = 'tool.pre' AND ts < ?
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts<?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.HandoffEffect
SELECT s.handoff, s.started_at, (SELECT MIN(e.ts) FROM events e WHERE e.sid = s.sid AND e.kind = 'tool.pre' AND e.tool IN ('Edit','Write','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')) AS first_edit, s.session_id FROM sessions s WHERE s.handoff IN (1, 2)
    SCAN s
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=?)

## store.HermesSpend
SELECT COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload,'$.cost_basis'),''), COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload,'$.hermes_source'),''), COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload,'$.background'),0), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.cost_usd IS NULL AND COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM sessions s JOIN events e INDEXED BY idx_events_session_ts ON e.sid = s.sid AND e.ts >= ? WHERE s.agent = 'hermes' AND e.source = 'hermes' AND e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND json_valid(e.payload) AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.cost_basis') IS NOT NULL AND e.internal = 0 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    SEARCH s USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent (agent=?)
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=? AND ts>?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.HistoryFrom
SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(owned),0), COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN last_event_at > started_at THEN (last_event_at - started_at)/1000.0 END),0) FROM sessions WHERE last_event_at >= ?
    SCAN sessions

    SEARCH daily_stats USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_daily_stats_1 (day>?)

## store.IncForcedContinue

## store.IncForcedContinue

    SEARCH forced_continues USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_forced_continues_1 (session_id=? AND task_id=?)

## store.InheritOwned
UPDATE sessions SET owned = 1, worktree = COALESCE(NULLIF(worktree, ''), (SELECT worktree FROM sessions p WHERE p.session_id = ?)), spawn_command = COALESCE(NULLIF(spawn_command, ''), (SELECT spawn_command FROM sessions p WHERE p.session_id = ?)), subscription = COALESCE(NULLIF(subscription, ''), (SELECT subscription FROM sessions p WHERE p.session_id = ?), ''), chat = MAX(chat, (SELECT chat FROM sessions p WHERE p.session_id = ?)) WHERE session_id = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions p WHERE p.session_id = ? AND p.owned = 1)
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 5
        SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 4
        SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.InsertBrainVault

SELECT id FROM brain_vaults WHERE path = ?
    SEARCH brain_vaults USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_brain_vaults_1 (path=?)

## store.InsertBrainVaultNote

## store.InsertEvent
INSERT INTO events(ts, sid, source, kind, tool, payload, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd, key, model, cache_write_1h, agent_id, msg_id, touch_dir, tool_bytes, internal, inner_tool) VALUES(?, (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(sid, key) WHERE key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.InsertEvent
INSERT INTO sessions(session_id, cwd, project, model, transcript_path, git_branch, version, pid, started_at, last_event_at) VALUES(?, '', '', '', '', '', '', 0, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO NOTHING

## store.InsertProject

UPDATE projects SET archived_at = NULL WHERE root = ?
    SEARCH projects USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_projects_1 (root=?)

## store.IsRemoved
SELECT 1 FROM removed_sessions WHERE session_id = ?
    SEARCH removed_sessions USING PRIMARY KEY (session_id=?)

## store.KnownPRs
SELECT number, url, title, head, state, merged_at, closed_at, updated_at FROM github_prs WHERE repo = ?
    SEARCH github_prs USING PRIMARY KEY (repo=?)

## store.KnownPRs
SELECT url, MAX(number), MAX(title), MAX(merged_at), MAX(closed_at), MAX(last_at) FROM session_prs WHERE lower(substr(url, 1, ?)) = lower(?) GROUP BY url
    SCAN session_prs
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.LastBrainRuns
SELECT r.id, r.session_id, r.from_event_id, r.through_event_id, r.status, r.model, r.tokens_in, r.tokens_out, r.cost_usd, r.nodes, r.error, r.started_at, r.finished_at, COALESCE(s.project, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(s.title, ''), s.prompt, ''), COALESCE(s.agent, ''), COALESCE(r.gap_id, 0) FROM brain_runs r LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.status != 'skipped' AND r.session_id != 'caprock:retag' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT ?
    SCAN r
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.LastCompaction
SELECT b.ts, b.trigger, b.pre, b.dur, COALESCE(b.post, ( SELECT COALESCE(t.tokens_in, 0) + COALESCE(t.cache_read, 0) + COALESCE(t.cache_write, 0) FROM events t INDEXED BY idx_events_session_ts WHERE t.sid = b.sid AND t.ts >= b.ts AND t.ts < b.next AND t.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND t.internal = 0 AND t.tokens_in IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(t.tokens_in, 0) + COALESCE(t.cache_read, 0) + COALESCE(t.cache_write, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(t.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(t.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ORDER BY t.ts, t.id LIMIT 1 ), 0) FROM ( SELECT e.sid, e.ts, COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.trigger'), '') AS trigger, COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.pre_tokens'), 0) AS pre, COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.duration_ms'), 0) AS dur, NULLIF(json_extract(e.payload, '$.post_tokens'), 0) AS post, COALESCE(( SELECT MIN(n.ts) FROM events n INDEXED BY idx_events_kind_ts WHERE n.kind = 'context.compacted' AND n.ts > e.ts AND n.sid = e.sid AND COALESCE(n.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(n.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ), 9223372036854775807) AS next FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_kind_ts WHERE e.kind = 'context.compacted' AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND e.sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) ORDER BY e.ts DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT ? ) b ORDER BY b.ts DESC
    CO-ROUTINE b
        SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_ts (kind=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
        CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
            SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_events_kind_ts (kind=? AND ts>?)
    SCAN b
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH t USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)

## store.LastMainTurn
SELECT id, ts, (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), source, kind, COALESCE(tool,''), payload, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd, COALESCE(key,''), COALESCE(model,''), cache_write_1h, COALESCE(agent_id,'') FROM ( SELECT * FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC LIMIT ? ) e WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND e.tokens_in IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ORDER BY e.ts DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1
    CO-ROUTINE e
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCAN e
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.LastPermissionMode
SELECT mode FROM ( SELECT ts, id, CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN json_extract(payload, '$.permission_mode') END AS mode FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_session_ts WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND source = 'hook' AND kind <> 'tool.post' ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?) WHERE typeof(mode) = 'text' AND mode <> '' ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
    CO-ROUTINE (subquery-2)
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCAN (subquery-2)

## store.LastRun
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(e.ts), 0) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_user_turn WHERE e.sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND e.kind = 'turn.user' AND e.ts <= ? AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_user_turn (sid=? AND ts<?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.LastRun
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'turn.assistant' THEN cost_usd END), 0), COUNT(CASE WHEN kind = 'tool.pre' THEN 1 END) FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND ts >= ? AND ts <= ? AND internal = 0
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.LatestPRByDir
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(se.repo_root,''), se.cwd) AS dir, p.session_id, p.url, p.number, p.title, p.opened_at, p.merged_at, p.closed_at, p.last_at FROM session_prs p JOIN sessions se ON se.session_id = p.session_id ORDER BY p.last_at DESC
    SCAN p USING INDEX idx_session_prs_last
    SEARCH se USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.LatestRateLimit
SELECT window, ts, used_percentage, resets_at FROM rate_limit_latest WHERE window = ?
    SEARCH rate_limit_latest USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_rate_limit_latest_1 (window=?)

## store.LinkBrain
INSERT INTO brain_edges (src, dst, kind, weight, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (src, dst, kind) DO UPDATE SET weight = MIN(?, weight + excluded.weight)

## store.LinkBrain
UPDATE brain_vault_edges SET pre = 1 WHERE src = ? AND dst = ? AND kind = ?
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_edge (src=? AND dst=? AND kind=?)

## store.LinkToolCall
UPDATE events SET msg_id = ? WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND key = ? AND kind = ? AND msg_id IS NULL
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_sid_key (sid=? AND key=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.ListBrainVaults

    SCAN brain_vaults

## store.ListEvents
SELECT id, ts, (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), source, kind, COALESCE(tool,''), payload, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd, COALESCE(key,''), COALESCE(model,''), cache_write_1h, COALESCE(agent_id,'') FROM events e WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND id > ? ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=? AND id>?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.ListInbox
SELECT i.id, i.text, i.files, COALESCE(i.project_id, 0), COALESCE(p.root, ''), COALESCE(p.name, ''), i.from_device, i.created_at FROM inbox i LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC
    SCAN i USING INDEX idx_inbox_created
    SEARCH p USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.ListOwnedActive

    SCAN sessions

## store.ListProjects
SELECT id, root, name, kind, source, remote_url, default_branch, added_at, pinned, sort, defaults, COALESCE(archived_at, 0) FROM projects ORDER BY pinned DESC, sort, name COLLATE NOCASE, id
    SCAN projects
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ListProjects

    SCAN projects
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ListSavedPrompts

    SCAN s USING INDEX idx_saved_prompts_project

## store.ListSessionsQuery
SELECT session_id, COALESCE(cwd,''), COALESCE(project,''), COALESCE(model,''), COALESCE(started_at,0), COALESCE(last_event_at,0), status, COALESCE(transcript_path,''), has_hooks, has_transcript, COALESCE(git_branch,''), COALESCE(version,''), COALESCE(repo_root,''), COALESCE(repo_path,''), COALESCE(owned,0), COALESCE(worktree,''), COALESCE(spawn_command,''), COALESCE(pid,0), exit_code, COALESCE(agent,'claude'), COALESCE(title,''), COALESCE(prompt,''), COALESCE(worked_at,0), COALESCE(parent_session,''), COALESCE(native_id,''), COALESCE(relay_from,''), COALESCE(subscription,''), COALESCE(sessions.name,''), COALESCE(sessions.chat,0), COALESCE(sessions.archived_at,0), COALESCE(sessions.subagent_model,''), COALESCE(sessions.idle_ended_at,0), COALESCE(sessions.idle_ended_after,0), COALESCE((SELECT a.group_id || ' ' || a.n || ' ' || a.total FROM attempts a WHERE a.session_id = sessions.session_id), '') FROM sessions WHERE ((COALESCE(project,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(cwd,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(git_branch,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR prompt LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR session_id LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR sid IN (SELECT sid FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.user' AND payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')) OR (COALESCE(project,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(cwd,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(git_branch,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR prompt LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR session_id LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR sid IN (SELECT sid FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.user' AND payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '\'))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'ended' AND worked_at > 0 THEN worked_at ELSE last_event_at END DESC LIMIT ?
    SCAN sessions
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    LIST SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH a USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_attempts_1 (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ListSessionsQuery
SELECT session_id, COALESCE(cwd,''), COALESCE(project,''), COALESCE(model,''), COALESCE(started_at,0), COALESCE(last_event_at,0), status, COALESCE(transcript_path,''), has_hooks, has_transcript, COALESCE(git_branch,''), COALESCE(version,''), COALESCE(repo_root,''), COALESCE(repo_path,''), COALESCE(owned,0), COALESCE(worktree,''), COALESCE(spawn_command,''), COALESCE(pid,0), exit_code, COALESCE(agent,'claude'), COALESCE(title,''), COALESCE(prompt,''), COALESCE(worked_at,0), COALESCE(parent_session,''), COALESCE(native_id,''), COALESCE(relay_from,''), COALESCE(subscription,''), COALESCE(sessions.name,''), COALESCE(sessions.chat,0), COALESCE(sessions.archived_at,0), COALESCE(sessions.subagent_model,''), COALESCE(sessions.idle_ended_at,0), COALESCE(sessions.idle_ended_after,0), COALESCE((SELECT a.group_id || ' ' || a.n || ' ' || a.total FROM attempts a WHERE a.session_id = sessions.session_id), '') FROM sessions WHERE chat = 1 AND archived_at = 0 AND ((COALESCE(project,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(cwd,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(git_branch,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR prompt LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR session_id LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR sid IN (SELECT sid FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.user' AND payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')) OR (COALESCE(project,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(cwd,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(git_branch,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR prompt LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR session_id LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR sid IN (SELECT sid FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.user' AND payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '\'))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'ended' AND worked_at > 0 THEN worked_at ELSE last_event_at END DESC LIMIT ?
    SCAN sessions USING INDEX idx_sessions_chat
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    LIST SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH a USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_attempts_1 (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ListSessionsQuery
SELECT session_id, COALESCE(cwd,''), COALESCE(project,''), COALESCE(model,''), COALESCE(started_at,0), COALESCE(last_event_at,0), status, COALESCE(transcript_path,''), has_hooks, has_transcript, COALESCE(git_branch,''), COALESCE(version,''), COALESCE(repo_root,''), COALESCE(repo_path,''), COALESCE(owned,0), COALESCE(worktree,''), COALESCE(spawn_command,''), COALESCE(pid,0), exit_code, COALESCE(agent,'claude'), COALESCE(title,''), COALESCE(prompt,''), COALESCE(worked_at,0), COALESCE(parent_session,''), COALESCE(native_id,''), COALESCE(relay_from,''), COALESCE(subscription,''), COALESCE(sessions.name,''), COALESCE(sessions.chat,0), COALESCE(sessions.archived_at,0), COALESCE(sessions.subagent_model,''), COALESCE(sessions.idle_ended_at,0), COALESCE(sessions.idle_ended_after,0), COALESCE((SELECT a.group_id || ' ' || a.n || ' ' || a.total FROM attempts a WHERE a.session_id = sessions.session_id), '') FROM sessions WHERE chat = 1 AND archived_at = 0 AND ((COALESCE(project,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(cwd,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR COALESCE(git_branch,'') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR prompt LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR session_id LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR sid IN (SELECT sid FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.user' AND payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '\'))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'ended' AND worked_at > 0 THEN worked_at ELSE last_event_at END DESC LIMIT ?
    SCAN sessions USING INDEX idx_sessions_chat
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH a USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_attempts_1 (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ListTasks

## store.LiveSubagents
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT agent_id, MAX(ts) AS last, MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'agent.stop' THEN ts ELSE 0 END) AS stopped FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND ts >= ? AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_id <> '' GROUP BY agent_id ) WHERE stopped < last
    CO-ROUTINE (subquery-2)
        SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_agent_ts (sid=? AND ts>?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
        USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    SCAN (subquery-2)

## store.LoopTaxCalls

AND ts >= ? AND ts <= ? AND kind IN ('tool.pre','turn.assistant') ORDER BY ts, id
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.MarkBrainAutomation
INSERT INTO brain_runs (session_id, status, error, started_at, finished_at) SELECT ?, 'skipped', ?, ?, ? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_runs a WHERE a.session_id = ? AND a.status = 'skipped' AND a.error = 'automation')
    SCAN CONSTANT ROW
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH a USING INDEX idx_brain_runs_session (session_id=?)

## store.PendingBrainGaps

    SEARCH g USING INDEX idx_brain_gaps_status (status=?)
    SEARCH r USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.ProjectActivityByDir

    SCAN sessions
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.ProjectActivityByDir
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(s.repo_root,''), s.cwd) AS d, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd), 0) FROM events e JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.cost_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.ProjectActivityByDir
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(s.repo_root,''), s.cwd) AS d, s.session_id, (SELECT e.kind || '|' || COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') || '|' || CASE WHEN e.kind = 'agent.stop' AND json_valid(e.payload) THEN COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.last_assistant_message'), '') ELSE '' END FROM events e WHERE e.sid = s.sid ORDER BY e.ts DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1) FROM sessions s WHERE s.status != 'ended' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(s.repo_root,''), s.cwd, '') != ''
    SCAN s
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)

## store.RateLimitPace

    SEARCH rate_limit_history USING INDEX idx_rate_limit_history_window_ts (window=?)

## store.RateLimitSamples
SELECT ts, used_percentage, resets_at FROM rate_limit_history WHERE window = ? AND ts >= ? UNION SELECT ts, used_percentage, resets_at FROM rate_limit_latest WHERE window = ? AND ts >= ? ORDER BY 1
    MERGE (UNION)
        LEFT
            SEARCH rate_limit_history USING INDEX idx_rate_limit_history_window_ts (window=? AND ts>?)
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR LAST 2 TERMS OF ORDER BY
        RIGHT
            SEARCH rate_limit_latest USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_rate_limit_latest_1 (window=?)

## store.RateLimitsWithPrefix
SELECT window, ts, used_percentage, resets_at FROM rate_limit_latest WHERE substr(window, 1, length(?)) = ? ORDER BY window
    SCAN rate_limit_latest USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_rate_limit_latest_1

## store.ReadBrainGraph
SELECT n.id, n.kind, n.title, n.summary, n.session_id, COALESCE(n.event_id, 0), n.source_ts, n.project, n.manual, n.pinned, COALESCE(n.run_id, 0), n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.keywords FROM brain_nodes n WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project') AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id = n.id AND v.agents = 0) AND NOT (n.vault_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vaults v WHERE v.id = n.vault_id AND v.agents = 0))) AND n.project = ? ORDER BY n.pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_project (project=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ReadBrainGraph
SELECT n.id, n.kind, n.title, n.summary, n.session_id, COALESCE(n.event_id, 0), n.source_ts, n.project, n.manual, n.pinned, COALESCE(n.run_id, 0), n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.keywords FROM brain_nodes n WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project') ORDER BY n.pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT ?
    SCAN n
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ReadBrainGraph
SELECT src, dst, kind, weight FROM brain_edges
    SCAN brain_edges

## store.ReadEventsGen
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT gen FROM session_gen WHERE session_id = ?1), 0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_session_id WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?1)), 0)
    SCAN CONSTANT ROW
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH session_gen USING PRIMARY KEY (session_id=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.RecentCompactionStats
SELECT b.ts, b.trigger, b.pre, b.dur, COALESCE(b.post, ( SELECT COALESCE(t.tokens_in, 0) + COALESCE(t.cache_read, 0) + COALESCE(t.cache_write, 0) FROM events t INDEXED BY idx_events_session_ts WHERE t.sid = b.sid AND t.ts >= b.ts AND t.ts < b.next AND t.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND t.internal = 0 AND t.tokens_in IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(t.tokens_in, 0) + COALESCE(t.cache_read, 0) + COALESCE(t.cache_write, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(t.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(t.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ORDER BY t.ts, t.id LIMIT 1 ), 0) FROM ( SELECT e.sid, e.ts, COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.trigger'), '') AS trigger, COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.pre_tokens'), 0) AS pre, COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.duration_ms'), 0) AS dur, NULLIF(json_extract(e.payload, '$.post_tokens'), 0) AS post, COALESCE(( SELECT MIN(n.ts) FROM events n INDEXED BY idx_events_kind_ts WHERE n.kind = 'context.compacted' AND n.ts > e.ts AND n.sid = e.sid AND COALESCE(n.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(n.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ), 9223372036854775807) AS next FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_kind_ts WHERE e.kind = 'context.compacted' AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ORDER BY e.ts DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT ? ) b ORDER BY b.ts DESC
    CO-ROUTINE b
        SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_ts (kind=?)
        CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
            SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_events_kind_ts (kind=? AND ts>?)
    SCAN b
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH t USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)

## store.RecentDirs
SELECT d, COUNT(*), MAX(last_event_at) FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(repo_root,''), cwd) AS d, last_event_at FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(repo_root,''), cwd) != '' ) GROUP BY d ORDER BY 3 DESC
    SCAN sessions
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.RecentOwnedSessions
SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE owned = 1 AND last_event_at >= ?
    SCAN sessions

## store.RecentRepos
SELECT repo_root, session_id, MAX(last_event_at) FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(repo_root, '') <> '' AND last_event_at >= ? GROUP BY repo_root ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT ?
    SCAN sessions USING INDEX idx_sessions_repo_branch
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.RecordExit
INSERT INTO session_exits(session_id, code, ran_ms, early, tail, at) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET code = excluded.code, ran_ms = excluded.ran_ms, early = excluded.early, tail = excluded.tail, at = excluded.at

## store.RecordPR
INSERT INTO session_prs(session_id, url, number, title, opened_at, merged_at, closed_at, last_at) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(session_id, url) DO UPDATE SET title = CASE WHEN excluded.title != '' AND session_prs.title = '' THEN excluded.title ELSE session_prs.title END, opened_at = CASE WHEN excluded.opened_at > 0 AND (session_prs.opened_at = 0 OR excluded.opened_at < session_prs.opened_at) THEN excluded.opened_at ELSE session_prs.opened_at END, merged_at = MAX(session_prs.merged_at, excluded.merged_at), closed_at = MAX(session_prs.closed_at, excluded.closed_at), last_at = MAX(session_prs.last_at, excluded.last_at)

## store.RecordPR
SELECT url FROM session_prs WHERE session_id = ? AND number = ? ORDER BY last_at DESC LIMIT 1
    SEARCH session_prs USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1 (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.RemoveBrainVault
DELETE FROM brain_edges WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_edges v WHERE v.vault_id = ? AND v.pre = 0 AND v.src = brain_edges.src AND v.dst = brain_edges.dst AND v.kind = brain_edges.kind) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_edges o WHERE o.vault_id != ? AND o.src = brain_edges.src AND o.dst = brain_edges.dst AND o.kind = brain_edges.kind)
    SCAN brain_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH v USING PRIMARY KEY (vault_id=? AND src=? AND dst=? AND kind=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH o USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_edge (src=? AND dst=? AND kind=?)

## store.RemoveBrainVault
DELETE FROM brain_nodes WHERE kind = 'note' AND id IN ( SELECT s.node_id FROM brain_vault_notes s WHERE s.vault_id = ?) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes o WHERE o.node_id = brain_nodes.id AND o.vault_id != ?)
    SEARCH brain_nodes USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_brain_vault_notes_1 (vault_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH o USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
    SEARCH brain_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
    SEARCH brain_edges USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_dst (dst=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_edge (src=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_notes USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)

## store.RemoveBrainVault
DELETE FROM brain_vault_edges WHERE vault_id = ?
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING PRIMARY KEY (vault_id=?)

## store.RemoveBrainVault
DELETE FROM brain_vault_notes WHERE vault_id = ?
    SEARCH brain_vault_notes USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_brain_vault_notes_1 (vault_id=?)

## store.RemoveBrainVault
DELETE FROM brain_vaults WHERE id = ?
    SEARCH brain_vaults USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_edges USING PRIMARY KEY (vault_id=?)
    SEARCH brain_vault_notes USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_brain_vault_notes_1 (vault_id=?)

## store.RemoveBrainVault
SELECT DISTINCT s.node_id FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_nodes n ON n.id = s.node_id WHERE s.vault_id = ? AND (n.kind != 'note' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes o WHERE o.node_id = s.node_id AND o.vault_id != ?))
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_brain_vault_notes_1 (vault_id=?)
    SEARCH n USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH o USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR DISTINCT

## store.RemoveBrainVault
UPDATE brain_nodes SET vault_id = ( SELECT v.vault_id FROM brain_vault_edges v WHERE v.dst = brain_nodes.id OR v.src = brain_nodes.id LIMIT 1) WHERE vault_id = ?
    SEARCH brain_nodes USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_vault (vault_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        MULTI-INDEX OR
            INDEX 1
                SEARCH v USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_dst (dst=?)
            INDEX 2
                SEARCH v USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_edges_edge (src=?)

## store.SearchNotes
SELECT e.id, se.session_id, COALESCE(se.project,''), e.ts, COALESCE(e.model,''), COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') FROM events e LEFT JOIN sessions se ON se.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') != '' AND (json_extract(e.payload, '$.text') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR ( SELECT COALESCE(json_extract(p.payload, '$.prompt'), json_extract(p.payload, '$.text')) FROM events p WHERE p.sid = e.sid AND p.kind = 'turn.user' AND p.ts <= e.ts AND (p.ts < e.ts OR p.id < e.id) AND p.ts >= COALESCE(( SELECT w.ts FROM events w WHERE w.sid = e.sid AND w.ts <= e.ts AND (w.ts < e.ts OR w.id < e.id) ORDER BY w.ts DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET ?), 0) ORDER BY p.ts DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND e.id < ? ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=? AND id<?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH p USING INDEX idx_events_user_turn (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
        CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH w USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=? AND ts<?)
    SEARCH se USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.SearchNotes
SELECT e.id, se.session_id, COALESCE(se.project,''), e.ts, COALESCE(e.model,''), COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') FROM events e LEFT JOIN sessions se ON se.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') != '' AND (json_extract(e.payload, '$.text') LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR ( SELECT COALESCE(json_extract(p.payload, '$.prompt'), json_extract(p.payload, '$.text')) FROM events p WHERE p.sid = e.sid AND p.kind = 'turn.user' AND p.ts <= e.ts AND (p.ts < e.ts OR p.id < e.id) AND p.ts >= COALESCE(( SELECT w.ts FROM events w WHERE w.sid = e.sid AND w.ts <= e.ts AND (w.ts < e.ts OR w.id < e.id) ORDER BY w.ts DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET ?), 0) ORDER BY p.ts DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_id (kind=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH p USING INDEX idx_events_user_turn (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
        CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH w USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=? AND ts<?)
    SEARCH se USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT ?

## store.SessionCalls
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT e.id, e.ts, COALESCE(e.model, ''), e.cost_usd, e.tokens_in, e.tokens_out, e.cache_read, e.cache_write, e.cache_write_1h, COALESCE(e.msg_id, '') FROM events e WHERE e.sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND +e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ORDER BY e.ts DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT ?) ORDER BY 2 ASC, 1 ASC
    CO-ROUTINE (subquery-2)
        SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCAN (subquery-2)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.SessionCalls
SELECT e.msg_id, COALESCE(e.tool, ''), COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.tool_input'), '') FROM events e WHERE e.sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND +e.kind = 'tool.pre' AND COALESCE(e.msg_id, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 ORDER BY e.ts ASC, e.id ASC
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

AND +e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') != '' ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT ?

## store.SetHandoffBrain

    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.SetHandoffRunes
UPDATE sessions SET handoff_runes = ? WHERE session_id = ?
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.SetModuleDoc
INSERT INTO module_docs (module, collection, doc_id, data, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (module, collection, doc_id) DO UPDATE SET data = excluded.data, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

## store.SetName
UPDATE sessions SET name = ? WHERE session_id = ?
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.SetNativeID
UPDATE sessions SET native_id = ? WHERE session_id = ? AND native_id = ''
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.SetOffset
INSERT INTO transcript_offsets(path, session_id, offset, updated_at) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(path) DO UPDATE SET offset = excluded.offset, session_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.session_id,''), transcript_offsets.session_id), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

## store.SetParent
UPDATE sessions SET parent_session = ? WHERE session_id = ? AND parent_session = ''
    SEARCH sessions USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.SetProjectGit
UPDATE projects SET remote_url = ?, default_branch = ? WHERE id = ? AND (remote_url != ? OR default_branch != ?)
    SEARCH projects USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.SetProjectRepos
DELETE FROM project_repos WHERE path = ?
    SEARCH project_repos USING COVERING INDEX idx_project_repos_path (path=?)

## store.SetProjectRepos
DELETE FROM project_repos WHERE project_id = ?
    SEARCH project_repos USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_project_repos_1 (project_id=?)

## store.SetProjectRepos
INSERT INTO project_repos(project_id, path, added_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
