## store.SharedCards
SELECT id, url, image, delete_token, bytes, at FROM shared_cards ORDER BY at DESC
    SCAN shared_cards USING INDEX idx_shared_cards_at

## store.SpendByBranch
SELECT s.git_branch, COUNT(*), COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent,''),'claude')),''), COALESCE(SUM(st.cost_usd),0), COALESCE(MAX(s.last_event_at),0) FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_stats st ON st.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.repo_root = ? AND s.git_branch IS NOT NULL AND s.git_branch <> '' GROUP BY s.git_branch
    SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_sessions_repo_branch (repo_root=? AND git_branch>?)
    SEARCH st USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_stats_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR group_concat(DISTINCT)

## store.SpendByPR
SELECT s.session_id, COALESCE(p.url,''), COALESCE(p.opened_at,0), COALESCE(p.last_at,0), COALESCE(s.git_branch,''), s.status, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent,''),'claude'), COALESCE(s.subscription,''), COALESCE(st.cost_usd,0), COALESCE(st.tokens_in,0), COALESCE(st.tokens_out,0), COALESCE(st.cache_read,0), COALESCE(st.cache_write,0) FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_prs p ON p.session_id = s.session_id LEFT JOIN session_stats st ON st.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM session_prs WHERE url IN (?))
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN session_prs USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1
    SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
    SEARCH st USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_stats_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.SpendByPR
SELECT s.session_id, COALESCE(p.url,''), COALESCE(p.opened_at,0), COALESCE(p.last_at,0), COALESCE(s.git_branch,''), s.status, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent,''),'claude'), COALESCE(s.subscription,''), COALESCE(st.cost_usd,0), COALESCE(st.tokens_in,0), COALESCE(st.tokens_out,0), COALESCE(st.cache_read,0), COALESCE(st.cache_write,0) FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_prs p ON p.session_id = s.session_id LEFT JOIN session_stats st ON st.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM session_prs WHERE url IN (?)) OR s.session_id IN (?)
    MULTI-INDEX OR
        INDEX 1
            LIST SUBQUERY 1
                SCAN session_prs USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1
            SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
        INDEX 2
            SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    REUSE LIST SUBQUERY 1
    SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
    SEARCH st USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_stats_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

        SCAN session_prs USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1
    SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN session_prs USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1

## store.SpendByPR
SELECT s.session_id, s.git_branch, s.status, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent,''),'claude'), COALESCE(s.subscription,''), COALESCE(st.cost_usd,0), COALESCE(st.tokens_in,0), COALESCE(st.tokens_out,0), COALESCE(st.cache_read,0), COALESCE(st.cache_write,0), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_prs q WHERE q.session_id = s.session_id AND (q.opened_at > 0 OR q.merged_at > 0)) FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_stats st ON st.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.repo_root = ? AND s.git_branch IS NOT NULL AND s.git_branch <> ''
    SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_sessions_repo_branch (repo_root=? AND git_branch>?)
    SEARCH st USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_stats_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH q USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_prs_1 (session_id=?)

## store.SpendBySessionSince
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = events.sid), COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_attr_work WHERE sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id IN (?)) AND ts >= ? AND internal = 0 GROUP BY sid
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.SpendBySessionSince
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = events.sid), COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_attr_work WHERE sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?)) AND ts >= ? AND internal = 0 GROUP BY sid
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.SpendBySubscription
SELECT COALESCE(s.agent, 'claude'), s.subscription, COUNT(DISTINCT e.sid), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd), 0) FROM events e JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(s.agent, 'claude') IN ('claude', 'codex') GROUP BY 1, 2
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR count(DISTINCT)

## store.SpendOn
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_ts_cover JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.ts >= ? AND e.ts < ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.cost_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent,''),'claude') = ? AND COALESCE(s.subscription,'') = ?
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>? AND ts<?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.SpendPartsBetween
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent,''),'claude'), COALESCE(s.subscription,''), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_ts_cover LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.cost_usd > 0 AND e.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY 1, 2
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.SpendPartsBetween
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent,''),'claude'), COALESCE(s.subscription,''), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_ts_cover LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.cost_usd > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.SpendPartsBetween
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(s.agent,''),'claude'), COALESCE(s.subscription,''), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_ts_cover LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.ts >= ? AND e.ts < ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.cost_usd > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>? AND ts<?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.SpendSince
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd),0) FROM events WHERE ts >= ? AND internal = 0
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>?)

## store.SubagentTokensByModelSkip
SELECT COALESCE(model,''), COALESCE(SUM(tokens_in),0), COALESCE(SUM(tokens_out),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_read),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_write),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_write_1h),0) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_turn_agent WHERE kind = 'turn.assistant' AND ts >= ? AND ts < ? AND COALESCE(agent_id,'') <> '' AND cost_usd > 0 AND internal = 0 AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = 'claude') AND sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE cwd IN ('/')) GROUP BY 1
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN sessions
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.SubagentTokensByModelSkip
SELECT COALESCE(model,''), COALESCE(SUM(tokens_in),0), COALESCE(SUM(tokens_out),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_read),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_write),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_write_1h),0) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_turn_agent WHERE kind = 'turn.assistant' AND ts >= ? AND ts < ? AND COALESCE(agent_id,'') <> '' AND cost_usd > 0 AND internal = 0 AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = 'claude') GROUP BY 1
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.SubagentTrailOf
SELECT id, ts, kind, COALESCE(tool, ''), COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.tool_use_id'), ''), CASE WHEN kind = 'tool.pre' THEN json_extract(payload, '$.tool_input') END, COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.is_error'), 0), COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.agent_type'), ''), CASE WHEN kind = 'agent.stop' THEN json_extract(payload, '$.last_assistant_message') END, CASE WHEN kind = 'turn.assistant' THEN json_extract(payload, '$.tools') END, COALESCE(model, ''), tokens_in, COALESCE(tokens_out, 0), COALESCE(cache_read, 0), COALESCE(cache_write, 0), cost_usd, internal FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND agent_id = ? ORDER BY ts, id
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_agent (sid=? AND agent_id=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.SubagentsDone
SELECT agent_id, MIN(ts), MAX(ts), MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'agent.stop' THEN ts ELSE 0 END) AS stopped, SUM(kind = 'tool.pre') AS calls FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND ts >= ? AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_id <> '' GROUP BY agent_id HAVING stopped >= MAX(ts) AND calls > 0 ORDER BY stopped DESC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_agent_ts (sid=? AND ts>?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.SubagentsNow
SELECT agent_id, MIN(ts), MAX(ts), MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'agent.stop' THEN ts ELSE 0 END), SUM(kind = 'tool.pre') FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND ts >= ? AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_id <> '' GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY MAX(ts) DESC
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_agent_ts (sid=? AND ts>?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.SubagentsSpend
SELECT agent_id, MAX(ts), COALESCE(model, ''), COUNT(*), SUM(cost_usd IS NULL AND tokens_in IS NOT NULL), COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_subagent_turn WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND kind = 'turn.assistant' AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_id <> '' AND internal = 0 GROUP BY agent_id
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_subagent_turn (sid=? AND agent_id>?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.SummarizeSparkFor
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), 0 AS bucket, 0 AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0), 0, 0, 0 FROM events e WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY e.sid
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.SummarizeSparkFor
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), 0 AS bucket, 0 AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0), 0, 0, 0 FROM events e WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0 GROUP BY e.sid
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.SummarizeSparkFor
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), CASE WHEN e.ts < ? THEN -1 ELSE (e.ts - ?) / ? END AS bucket, CASE WHEN e.ts < ? THEN -1 ELSE (e.ts - ?) / 3600000 END AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0), COUNT(*), COUNT(e.cost_usd) FROM events e WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY e.sid, bucket, hr
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.SummarizeSparkFor
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), CASE WHEN e.ts < ? THEN -1 ELSE (e.ts - ?) / ? END AS bucket, CASE WHEN e.ts < ? THEN -1 ELSE (e.ts - ?) / 3600000 END AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0), COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0), COUNT(*), COUNT(e.cost_usd) FROM events e WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 0 GROUP BY e.sid, bucket, hr
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.SummarizeSparkFor
SELECT COALESCE(model,''), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(cache_read,0)+COALESCE(cache_write,0)),0), COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd),0), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tokens_out,0)),0), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cache_read,0)),0) FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.assistant' AND ts >= ? AND internal = 0 AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY model ORDER BY 3 DESC
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.TaskSessions
SELECT a.session_id, COALESCE(s.cwd, ''), a.from_ts, COALESCE(a.to_ts, 0) FROM task_assignments a LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = a.session_id WHERE a.task_id = ? ORDER BY a.from_ts DESC
    SEARCH a USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_assignments_1 (task_id=?)
    SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.TokensByModel

    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.ToolDistribution
SELECT COALESCE(tool,'?') AS t, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'tool.pre' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(tool_bytes), 0) AS bytes FROM events WHERE kind IN ('tool.pre','tool.post') AND tool != '' AND ts >= ? AND internal = 0 GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT ?
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_tool_dist (kind=? AND ts>?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.ToolDrillStats
SELECT pr.ts, COALESCE(f.drill_key, ''), COALESCE(f.drill_by, ''), CASE WHEN pr.id <= (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(v AS INTEGER)), 0) FROM meta WHERE k = 'tool_fields_pending') THEN pr.payload END, po.id IS NOT NULL, CASE WHEN po.id <= (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(v AS INTEGER)), 0) FROM meta WHERE k = 'tool_fields_pending') THEN json_valid(po.payload) AND COALESCE(json_extract(po.payload, '$.is_error'), 0) <> 0 ELSE COALESCE(pf.is_error, 0) END, COALESCE(po.tool_bytes, 0) FROM events pr LEFT JOIN tool_fields f ON f.event_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN events po ON po.sid = pr.sid AND po.key = 'post:' || substr(pr.key, 5) LEFT JOIN tool_fields pf ON pf.event_id = po.id WHERE pr.kind = 'tool.pre' AND pr.tool = ? AND pr.ts >= ? AND pr.internal = 0 ORDER BY pr.ts
    SEARCH pr USING INDEX idx_events_kind_ts (kind=? AND ts>?)
    SEARCH f USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
    SEARCH po USING INDEX idx_events_sid_key (sid=? AND key=?) LEFT-JOIN
    SEARCH pf USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH meta USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_meta_1 (k=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH meta USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_meta_1 (k=?)

## store.TrendsAt
SELECT ts / ? AS b, (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = events.sid), kind, COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(tokens_in),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_read),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_write),0), COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd),0) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_ts_cover WHERE ts >= ? AND internal = 0 AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY b, sid, kind
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.TrendsAt

AS b, (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = events.sid), kind, COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(tokens_in),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_read),0), COALESCE(SUM(cache_write),0), COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd),0) FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_ts_cover WHERE ts >= ? AND internal = 0 GROUP BY b, sid, kind
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.UnlinkBrain

    MULTI-INDEX OR
        INDEX 1
            SEARCH brain_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=? AND src=?)
        INDEX 2
            SEARCH brain_edges USING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=? AND src=?)

## store.UnlinkBrainKind

    SEARCH brain_edges USING PRIMARY KEY (src=? AND dst=? AND kind=?)

## store.UnmeasuredBrainGaps

    SCAN g
    SEARCH r USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.UpsertSession
INSERT INTO sessions(session_id, cwd, project, model, started_at, last_event_at, status, transcript_path, has_hooks, has_transcript, git_branch, version, repo_root, repo_path, agent, pid, title, worked_at, parent_session, subscription) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), 'claude'), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET cwd = CASE WHEN ? THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(sessions.cwd, ''), excluded.cwd) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.cwd, ''), sessions.cwd) END, project = CASE WHEN ? THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(sessions.project, ''), excluded.project) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.project, ''), sessions.project) END, repo_root = CASE WHEN ? THEN excluded.repo_root ELSE COALESCE(sessions.repo_root, excluded.repo_root) END, repo_path = CASE WHEN ? THEN excluded.repo_path ELSE COALESCE(sessions.repo_path, excluded.repo_path) END, model = CASE WHEN ? != '' THEN excluded.model ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(sessions.model, ''), NULLIF(excluded.model, ''), sessions.model) END, transcript_path = CASE WHEN ? THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(sessions.transcript_path, ''), excluded.transcript_path) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.transcript_path, ''), sessions.transcript_path) END, git_branch = CASE WHEN ? THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(sessions.git_branch, ''), excluded.git_branch) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.git_branch, ''), sessions.git_branch) END, version = COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.version, ''), sessions.version), started_at = MIN(sessions.started_at, excluded.started_at), last_event_at = MAX(sessions.last_event_at, excluded.last_event_at), status = CASE WHEN ? != '' THEN ? WHEN sessions.status = 'ended' AND excluded.last_event_at <= sessions.last_event_at THEN 'ended' ELSE 'active' END, has_hooks = MAX(sessions.has_hooks, excluded.has_hooks), has_transcript = MAX(sessions.has_transcript, excluded.has_transcript), agent = COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.agent, ''), sessions.agent), pid = CASE WHEN excluded.pid > 0 THEN excluded.pid ELSE sessions.pid END, title = COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.title, ''), sessions.title), worked_at = MAX(sessions.worked_at, excluded.worked_at), parent_session = COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.parent_session, ''), sessions.parent_session), subscription = COALESCE(NULLIF(sessions.subscription, ''), excluded.subscription)

## store.UpsertTask
INSERT INTO tasks(id, title, status, assignee, budget_usd, verify_rounds, cost_usd, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET title = excluded.title, status = excluded.status, assignee = excluded.assignee, budget_usd = excluded.budget_usd, verify_rounds = excluded.verify_rounds, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

## store.UsualSince

AND internal = 0 AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY sid, h
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

AND internal = 0 GROUP BY sid, h
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1

## store.WhereWeLeftOff
SELECT e.id, (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), ?, e.ts, COALESCE(e.model,''), COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_turn_agent WHERE e.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE project = ?) AND e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text'), '') != '' AND e.ts < ? AND LENGTH(json_extract(e.payload, '$.text')) >= ? ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 1
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts<?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_repo
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

AND ts < ? AND internal = 0 AND sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE cwd IN ('/')) GROUP BY sid, 2

## store.brainEdgesAmong
SELECT e.src, e.dst, e.kind, e.weight FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.src IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND e.dst IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
    SEARCH e USING PRIMARY KEY (src=? AND dst=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:

## store.brainEdgesTouching
SELECT e.src, e.dst, e.kind, e.weight FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.src IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) UNION SELECT e.src, e.dst, e.kind, e.weight FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.dst IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
    MERGE (UNION)
        LEFT
            SEARCH e USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
            LIST SUBQUERY 1
                SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
        RIGHT
            SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
            LIST SUBQUERY 3
                SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.brainEntityDocs
SELECT id, search FROM brain_nodes n WHERE kind IN ('topic','person','project')
    SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_entity (kind=?)

## store.brainEntityDocs
SELECT id, search FROM brain_nodes n WHERE kind IN ('topic','person','project') AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id = n.id AND v.agents = 0) AND NOT (n.vault_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vaults v WHERE v.id = n.vault_id AND v.agents = 0)))
    SEARCH n USING INDEX idx_brain_nodes_entity (kind=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.brainLinkedTo
SELECT e.src, e.dst FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.src IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) UNION SELECT e.src, e.dst FROM brain_edges e WHERE e.dst IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
    MERGE (UNION)
        LEFT
            SEARCH e USING PRIMARY KEY (src=?)
            LIST SUBQUERY 1
                SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
        RIGHT
            SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_dst (dst=?)
            LIST SUBQUERY 3
                SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
            USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

    SEARCH brain_vault_notes USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)

## store.brainSupersededBy

    SEARCH brain_edges USING COVERING INDEX idx_brain_edges_supersedes (dst=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:

## store.countSubagentCalls
SELECT agent_id, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.tool_use_id'), 'event:' || id)) FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND +kind = 'tool.pre' AND agent_id IN (?) GROUP BY agent_id
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_agent (sid=? AND agent_id=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR count(DISTINCT)

## store.describeSubagents
SELECT (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN json_extract(payload, '$.tool_response.agentId') END), (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN json_extract(payload, '$.tool_response.description') END) FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND kind = 'tool.post' AND tool IN ('Agent', 'Task') AND (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN json_extract(payload, '$.tool_response.agentId') END) IN (?)
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.describeSubagents
SELECT f.agent_id, COALESCE(f.agent_desc, '') FROM tool_fields f INDEXED BY idx_tool_fields_agent JOIN events e ON e.id = f.event_id WHERE f.agent_id IN (?) AND e.sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND e.kind = 'tool.post' AND e.tool IN ('Agent', 'Task')
    SEARCH f USING COVERING INDEX idx_tool_fields_agent (agent_id=?)
    SEARCH e USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.eventsBefore
SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, ts, (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), source, kind, COALESCE(tool,''), payload, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd, COALESCE(key,''), COALESCE(model,''), cache_write_1h, COALESCE(agent_id,'') FROM events e WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND (ts < (SELECT ts FROM events WHERE id = ?) OR (ts = (SELECT ts FROM events WHERE id = ?) AND id < ?)) ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?) ORDER BY ts ASC, id ASC
    CO-ROUTINE (subquery-5)
        SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
            SEARCH events USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 4
            SEARCH events USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
        CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    SCAN (subquery-5)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

AND COALESCE(e.agent_id, '') = '' AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.sidechain') IS NOT 1 AND e.kind IN (?, ?) ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?) ORDER BY ts ASC, id ASC
    CO-ROUTINE (subquery-3)
        SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
        CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    SCAN (subquery-3)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.learnMatch
WITH a(i, at) AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT CAST(key AS INTEGER), CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM json_each(?)) SELECT a.i, s.session_id, MIN(e.ts) FROM a CROSS JOIN events p INDEXED BY idx_events_tool_dist JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = p.sid AND s.repo_root = ? JOIN events e ON e.sid = p.sid AND e.key = 'post:' || substr(p.key, 5) WHERE p.kind = 'tool.pre' AND p.ts >= a.at - ? AND p.ts < a.at + 1000 AND p.tool = 'Bash' AND p.internal = 0 AND p.key LIKE 'pre:%' AND e.ts >= a.at GROUP BY a.i, p.sid
    MATERIALIZE a
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
    SCAN a
    SEARCH p USING INDEX idx_events_tool_dist (kind=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_sid_key (sid=? AND key=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.learnRepo
SELECT url, MAX(opened_at > 0), MAX(merged_at > 0) FROM session_prs WHERE lower(substr(url, 1, ?)) = lower(?) GROUP BY url
    SCAN session_prs
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

## store.learnRepo

    SEARCH github_prs USING PRIMARY KEY (repo=?)

## store.linkParentCall
SELECT ts, kind, COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.tool_use_id'), ''), COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.tool_input'), '{}'), CASE WHEN kind = 'tool.post' THEN json_extract(payload, '$.tool_response') END FROM events WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND +kind IN ('tool.pre', 'tool.post') AND tool IN ('Agent', 'Task') AND COALESCE(agent_id, '') = '' AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY ts, id
    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_ts (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)

## store.putToolFields
INSERT INTO tool_fields(event_id, drill_key, drill_by, is_error, agent_id, agent_desc) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO UPDATE SET drill_key = excluded.drill_key, drill_by = excluded.drill_by, is_error = excluded.is_error, agent_id = excluded.agent_id, agent_desc = excluded.agent_desc

## store.queryBackgroundUsage
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(e.model,''), s.model, ''), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0) FROM events e JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 1 AND e.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(e.model,''), s.model, '') ORDER BY 3 DESC
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.queryBackgroundUsage
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(e.model,''), s.model, ''), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0) FROM events e JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.internal = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(e.model,''), s.model, '') ORDER BY 3 DESC
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.queryUnpriced
SELECT COALESCE(model,''), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(cache_read,0)+COALESCE(cache_write,0)),0) FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.assistant' AND ts >= ? AND cost_usd IS NULL AND (COALESCE(tokens_in,0) + COALESCE(tokens_out,0) + COALESCE(cache_read,0) + COALESCE(cache_write,0)) > 0 AND internal = 0 AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY model ORDER BY 3 DESC
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.queryUnpriced
SELECT COALESCE(model,''), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(cache_read,0)+COALESCE(cache_write,0)),0) FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn.assistant' AND ts >= ? AND cost_usd IS NULL AND (COALESCE(tokens_in,0) + COALESCE(tokens_out,0) + COALESCE(cache_read,0) + COALESCE(cache_write,0)) > 0 AND internal = 0 GROUP BY model ORDER BY 3 DESC
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>?)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.rateHours
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), (e.ts - ?) / 3600000 AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0), COUNT(e.cost_usd), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(e.tokens_out,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_read,0)+COALESCE(e.cache_write,0)),0) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_turn_agent WHERE e.kind = 'turn.assistant' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.ts < ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE repo_root IN (?)) GROUP BY e.sid, hr
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_repo_branch (repo_root=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.rateHours

AND e.ts < ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE repo_root IN (?,?)) GROUP BY e.sid, hr
    SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_turn_agent (kind=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_repo_branch (repo_root=?)
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

AND e.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE agent = 'claude' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(repo_root, ''), cwd) = ?)) ORDER BY e.sid, e.ts

## store.runFiles
SELECT p FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.tool_input.file_path'), json_extract(payload, '$.tool_input.notebook_path'), '') AS p, MIN(ts) AS first FROM events INDEXED BY idx_events_attr_work WHERE sid = (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?) AND kind = 'tool.pre' AND ts >= ? AND ts <= ? AND internal = 0 AND tool IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') GROUP BY 1 ) WHERE p <> '' ORDER BY first, p
    CO-ROUTINE (subquery-2)
        SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
        SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH sessions USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
        USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
    SCAN (subquery-2)
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

## store.scanLoopSeries
SELECT s.session_id, COALESCE(s.agent,'claude'), COALESCE(e.tool,''), e.ts, COALESCE(e.msg_id,''), CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.agent_id,'') != '' THEN e.agent_id WHEN instr(e.payload, '"sidechain":true') > 0 THEN 'sidechain' ELSE '' END, COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(e.payload) THEN e.payload -> '$.tool_input' END, '') FROM events e LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.kind = 'tool.pre' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.ts < ? AND e.internal = 0 AND COALESCE(e.tool,'') NOT IN ('Glob','Grep','NotebookRead','Read','ToolSearch')
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_tool_dist (kind=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN

## store.scanToolPosts
SELECT (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE sessions.sid = e.sid), COALESCE(e.key,''), COALESCE(e.tool,''), e.ts, COALESCE(e.payload ->> '$.hook_event_name', ''), COALESCE(CAST(e.payload ->> '$.is_error' AS INTEGER), 0), COALESCE(e.payload ->> '$.cwd', ''), COALESCE(CAST(e.payload ->> '$.duration_ms' AS INTEGER), 0), COALESCE(e.payload -> '$.tool_input', ''), CASE WHEN e.tool = 'Bash' THEN COALESCE(e.payload -> '$.tool_response', '') ELSE '' END, COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_type(e.payload, '$.tool_response') = 'object' THEN CAST(e.payload ->> '$.tool_response.interrupted' AS INTEGER) END, 0) FROM events e WHERE e.kind = 'tool.post' AND e.ts >= ? AND e.ts < ? AND e.internal = 0 AND e.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE cwd IN ('/')) AND e.tool IN ('Bash','Edit','Write','MultiEdit') AND json_valid(e.payload) ORDER BY e.ts, e.id
    SEARCH e USING INDEX idx_events_kind_ts (kind=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 2
        SCAN sessions
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH sessions USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

## store.searchBrain
SELECT n.id, n.search, n.pinned, n.created_at FROM brain_nodes n WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('topic','person','project') AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vault_notes s JOIN brain_vaults v ON v.id = s.vault_id WHERE s.node_id = n.id AND v.agents = 0) AND NOT (n.vault_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_vaults v WHERE v.id = n.vault_id AND v.agents = 0))) ORDER BY n.id DESC
    SCAN n
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH s USING INDEX idx_brain_vault_notes_node (node_id=?)
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
        SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

    SEARCH events USING INDEX idx_events_session_id (sid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1

## store.sliceSums
WITH a(i, sid, lo, hi) AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT CAST(key AS INTEGER), (SELECT s.sid FROM sessions s WHERE s.session_id = json_extract(value, '$[0]')), json_extract(value, '$[1]'), json_extract(value, '$[2]') FROM json_each(?)) SELECT a.i, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.cost_usd),0) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_attr_work WHERE e.sid = a.sid AND e.ts > a.lo AND e.ts <= a.hi AND e.internal = 0), (SELECT json_array(COALESCE(SUM(e.tokens_in),0), COALESCE(SUM(e.tokens_out),0), COALESCE(SUM(e.cache_read),0), COALESCE(SUM(e.cache_write),0)) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_attr_work WHERE e.sid = a.sid AND e.ts > a.lo AND e.ts <= a.hi AND e.internal = 0) FROM a
    MATERIALIZE a
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
        CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
            SEARCH s USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sessions_1 (session_id=?)
    SCAN a
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 4
        SEARCH e USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_attr_work (sid=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)

## store.subtractDayTurns
SELECT project FROM daily_sessions WHERE day = ? AND session_id = ?
    SEARCH daily_sessions USING PRIMARY KEY (day=?)

## store.subtractDayTurns
UPDATE daily_stats SET tokens_total = 0, cost_usd = 0 WHERE rowid = (SELECT rowid FROM daily_stats WHERE day = ? AND model = ? AND tokens_total = ? AND abs(cost_usd - ?) < 1e-9 LIMIT 1)
    SEARCH daily_stats USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
    SCALAR SUBQUERY 1
        SEARCH daily_stats USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_daily_stats_1 (day=?)

## store.sumKinds

AND internal = 0 AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM sessions WHERE COALESCE(agent,'claude') = ?) GROUP BY kind
    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
        SCAN sessions USING COVERING INDEX idx_sessions_agent
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
    USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_ts_cover (ts>?)

## store.tableSizes
SELECT COALESCE(m.tbl_name, d.name), m.type, d.pgsize FROM dbstat AS d LEFT JOIN sqlite_schema AS m ON m.name = d.name WHERE d.aggregate = TRUE
    SCAN d VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 0x4:
    SCAN m LEFT-JOIN

## store.weekSpans

    SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX idx_events_kind_ts (kind=? AND ts>? AND ts<?)
